Karnataka CM Criticizes BJP Over Police Warning During Ganesh Procession

Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah stated that the BJP was politicizing a routine police warning issued in T Narasipura regarding a Ganesh procession. He urged against creating unrest. The comments came after police reportedly issued a warning ahead of the procession, which Shivakumar, the state's Deputy Chief Minister, characterized as a standard procedure. The BJP has been accused by Shivakumar of misrepresenting the situation.
